chain.core_message: Every new scaffold starts with the PMF telemetry seam already present, fail-open, and ready to enrich.
proof_points: Product Lead build_spec requires a single track(event, props) seam with no-op fail-open sink.
Director of Product ruled activation must be early-derived at canon and lastmile-confirmed.
W0 enforcer extends scaffold coverage with planted seam-missing, broken-chain, duplicate-sink, and unfilled-activation fixtures.
chain.market_promise: Founders get day-zero activation, retention, core-action, checkout, and chain-integrity signal without waiting for late analytics installation.

acceptance_criteria: track() no-ops and never throws when no sink is configured.
track() uses exactly one sink resolver and swallows sink errors.
LIFECYCLE_EVENTS is exactly signup, onboarding_complete, activation, core_action, retention_return, checkout.
ACTIVATION_DEFINITION is filled, provenance/confidence-marked, and placeholders fail closed.
Lastmile analytics enriches the seam vocabulary and emits activation_definition_change on revision.
Chain helper reports sent/committed without delivered/observed as broken, not complete.
Scaffold coverage fails planted seam-missing, duplicate-sink, broken-chain, and unfilled-activation fixtures.
New telemetry template files ship through regenerated framework and WarpOS manifests.
implementation_sequence: R-1 seam templates and env names
R-2/R-5 event vocabulary and chain helper
R-3 activation definition and canon/lastmile behavior
R-6 scaffold coverage fixtures and manifest shipping proof
